subject: prd/implement-now
statement: Where the strongest-profile kill switch is engaged for implementation, the selected harness adapter shall prefer its strongest approved native implementation profile only when that profile satisfies every requested semantic minimum; otherwise FR-24 applies, with harness selection and frozen demand unchanged.
rationale: fallback may spend more but may never weaken or escape the task contract
fit_criterion: per-harness drills prove the fallback dominates every resolved request, never switches harness, and produces an unsupported result with zero claim/invocation when even the strongest qualified profile is insufficient
